residualRegister.fix: H1: adding retrieve_result breaks exact built-in-surface assertions in cmd/mcp-bridge (serve_hybrid_exposure_test.go:201; serve_hybrid_reload_test.go:225,238,262; serve_hybrid_progressive_reveal_lifecycle_test.go:278-286,492; serve_hybrid_progressive_reveal_test.go:352-390; serve_oauth_test.go:449,500) that are neither write roots nor owned by a task; enumerate the complete assertion set from a directory-wide search and own it.

H2: session-less retrieval is admitted to the publisher projection by admitExposureRequest (session_exposure.go:105-120), so the observable is invalid_handle in that namespace, not rejection; AC17 as written cannot pass.
H3: the changed-claim list omits README.md:288, :338 and :443, so T6 greps pass while documented claims stay false.
H4: R1/R3 assert absolute 1536/8192 while §4.5 makes both ceilings configurable; state that the preview and page bounds are the configured ceilings.
H5: oracles for AC1,2,3,4,5,7,8,9,10,11,14 appear in no task -run; AC2 is owned by T1, which may not wire handlers.
H6: zero content is false; errorResult always emits one TextContent, so require zero retained-result or page bytes and assert that.
L1: remaining_pages/remaining_bytes arithmetic is undefined, so any convention passes.
L2: preview/page shapes cannot appear in a stored input schema and AC6 does not test that clause.
L3: handle_ttl is omitted from config validation, so zero or negative is accepted and expires every handle immediately.
L4: T7 validation writes coverage.out while T7 prohibits any write and no write root covers it.

R1: the claimed-complete built-in inventory misses internal/service/tool_metadata_test.go:108-120, internal/service/tools_publish_atomic_test.go:50-57 and cmd/mcp-bridge/serve_test.go:618, so T3 fails inside its envelope; make the inventory repo-complete and every hit a write root.

R2: unbounded upstream_code is copied into the preview and every page while the partition assumes bounded metadata, so a long code breaks the 1536 preview or the 8192 page with no truncation or termination rule.

R3: R7/AC15 require rejecting an out-of-range page before store access, but total_pages needs the owner-namespaced lookup, and page is optional with default 1; split pre-store shape checks from post-lookup range checks.
R4: the four metrics need internal/observe/metrics.go and the new events need docs/logging-contract.md, neither of which is a write root or expected file, while §8 ties metric scraping to AC9/T2.
R5: R6 requires preview/page shapes in the tool description, but AC6 checks only the stored input schema and README and no task owns description text.

R6: the unretainable branch specifies no Content prefix and never states that MCP isError mirrors the original, so AC13 passes with a metadata-only preview and an unretainable error can ship with isError false.

R7: the invalidation list omits SDK-session-loss retirement (inbound.go:800-816 retires the owner; :850/:921 mint a new epoch) while T2 names only reaper purge, so unreachable old-incarnation entries hold the aggregate cap.
R8: T6 negative greps forbid phrases that §6 requires documenting as still true at or below the ceiling, so T6 blocks truthful qualified wording.

M1: config validation bounds only max_metadata_envelope_bytes < delivery_ceiling_bytes, so a loadable config can make the preview non-empty-content requirement impossible (preview ceiling below preview metadata, whose digit widths are derived from a bound that cannot bound an unretained total_bytes); add a preview-feasibility validation and typed fallback.

M2: R10/§4.6 promise the full upstream code byte-exact on every branch while §4.2 truncates it, and the unretainable branch has no retained result; scope the promise to the retainable branch and state the unretainable observable.
L1: the description half names no observable, so a description with no paging fields passes; name the tokens the description must carry.

L2: rehydration never retires an epoch-bearing owner (newLiveOwner runs only when the record epoch is 0 at inbound.go:609/850/921), so the four-seam purge claim is vacuous; state epoch-keyed namespaces plus purge on reaper, DELETE and SDK-session-loss, and state both observables when a caller presents a retired epoch.
L3: the four collectors and new log events are tied to AC9/AC10 but no R/AC verifies them, so their deliverables can neither pass nor fail; add an AC or mark them advisory.
